label: Introduction
text: Welcome. This is the Student Reward System: a web application for recognising participation, recording points, and making reward activity easier to review.

label: The need
text: Participation and achievement deserve to be recognised consistently. When records and reward rules are difficult to review, it takes extra effort to see what has been awarded. This project brings those workflows into one place.

label: How it works
text: An administrator signs in and uses the browser interface. Flask handles the application routes and validation, while MySQL stores the system records. History and leaderboard views make recorded activity easier to review.

label: Core workflows
text: Administrators can manage participant records, configure point rules, and record awards using active activities. The system also provides transaction history, goals, manually entered progress, and reporting.

label: Point rules
text: Point rules define activities, values, and daily limits. In this prepared screen, attendance is worth ten points and the active workshop rule is worth fifty points, with a limit of one per day. Inactive rules are also visible.

label: Award validation
text: To award points, select a participant and an active activity, then record the transaction. The application checks awards against its rules, including inactive activities, duplicate awards, and daily limits.

label: Leaderboard
text: The leaderboard summarizes recorded points so activity can be reviewed at a glance. This visual uses illustrative sample names and values for privacy; check the live application for current records.

label: Goals and progress
text: Goals and progress are part of the system, with one important scope note: progress is entered manually. It is not automatically calculated from point transactions.

label: Testing
text: The project automated test run completed with twenty-nine tests passing. These checks cover unit behavior and schema expectations. They do not replace a live MySQL acceptance test.

label: Conclusion
text: The Student Reward System provides a practical foundation for managing participants, reward rules, point awards, and progress. Its history and leaderboard views help make recorded activity easier to review. Thank you.
